objective: Reduce ordinary Custom Prompt generation latency by removing unrelated context/reasoning work while preserving the shared semantic prompt contract and hard safety, privacy, capability and constraint boundaries.

constraints.text: Preserve extension.prompt_specification_architect as the shared semantic core; do not trade away hard requirements or safety/capability boundaries for speed.
constraints.provenance: current user-approved optimization scope + existing prompt architecture

constraints.text: Workspace continuity and decision records remain available but should load only when the current prompt task materially requires them.
Do not claim a 2-3x wall-clock speedup without observed timing evidence.

claims.text: The ordinary Custom Prompt instruction packet decreased from 43,492 to 14,371 characters after progressive activation and selective policy loading.
claims.provenance: pre-change and post-change instruction_packet measurements in this directive

claims.text: That packet is about 66.96% smaller, or approximately 3.03x smaller by character count; this is context-size reduction, not measured model wall-clock speed.
FAST keeps the prompt specification architect active while lazily excluding workspace continuity and decision records until matching task features are supplied.

evidence.source: directive-local packet measurements: baseline=43492 chars, FAST=14371 chars

assumptions.text: Reducing instruction context and candidate breadth is expected to reduce host work for ordinary prompt generation, but the magnitude depends on model/platform behavior.
assumptions.provenance: performance hypothesis; not treated as measured speed

alternatives.option: Delete semantic prompt-contract checks to maximize speed.
alternatives.reason: Would directly sacrifice prompt quality and correctness.

alternatives.option: Keep every prompt module/policy hot and only change decision depth.
alternatives.reason: Would leave the largest observed packet-context overhead intact.

alternatives.option: Use progressive activation with a four-module always-hot core, one-candidate FAST default and gated escalation.
alternatives.reason: Removes measured context overhead while preserving the prompt architect and recoverable deeper paths.

decision: Adopt prompt progressive activation in v0.24.0: Custom Prompt defaults to FAST/direct/speed with one candidate and prompt-only output; Prompt Enhancer starts STANDARD; workspace/audit/specialized guidance is lazy; material ambiguity, research, enhancement, security and high-consequence signals escalate to STANDARD or DEEP.

unknowns.text: Actual end-to-end model wall-clock improvement has not yet been measured on representative prompt-generation sessions.
unknowns.provenance: no representative pre/post host timing benchmark yet

verification.check: Full deterministic regression suite passed 66/66 before this decision-record append
Semantic fixed point reached in 2 passes before this decision-record append
FAST packet measured at 14,371 characters versus 43,492 baseline
